verdict.rationale: Productboard's docs describe connecting feedback to features, components, and other product hierarchy entities, with dedicated relationship endpoints. They also cover features and subfeatures, and adding features to initiatives. Notes can be linked to features to quantify demand. Most of this evidence is framed through the API and MCP server rather than the in-app organizing workflow. Missing for 10: first-party docs on organizing the hierarchy in the UI (e.g., how components nest within the product hierarchy), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
